Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)

This visa is for invited workers and New Zealand citizens with skills we need, to live and work permanently anywhere in Australia.

Eligibility

To apply for this visa you must be invited to apply. You must also meet the basic requirements below.

Age requirement

Applicants must be under 45 years of age at the time of invitation.

Work experience

Applicants must have at least three (3) years of relevant full-time work experience in a nominated skilled occupation.

Skills assessment

Applicants must have a suitable skills assessment for a nominated skilled occupation on the relevant skilled occupation list.

The skills assessment must be current and valid at the time of invitation, unless the assessing authority states otherwise.

Occupation

The nominated occupation must be on the Medium and Long-term Strategic Skills List at the time of invitation.

English language

Applicants must have competent English or an approved equivalent test result.

Applicants may be exempt from the English language requirement if they hold a passport from the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, New Zealand or Ireland.

Points test

You must score at least 65 points on the points test to be eligible to submit an expression of interest.

FactorPoints

Health requirement

Applicants and their family members included in the application must meet the health requirement.

Character requirement

Applicants must satisfy the character requirement, including providing a penal clearance certificate for each country lived in for 12 months or more in the last 10 years.

Invitation

Applicants cannot apply for this visa unless they have been invited to apply by the Department.

An invitation is valid for 60 days from the date it is issued.

Nomination

This subclass does not require state or territory nomination, unlike the Skilled Nominated visa (subclass 190).

Visa validity

This is a permanent visa. Once granted, holders can travel to and from Australia for five years from the date of grant.

Application fee

The base application charge for the main applicant is subject to the fee schedule published by the Department, and additional charges apply for each family member included in the application.

Family members

Applicants may include a partner and dependent children in the application, subject to the family member meeting public interest criteria including health and character requirements.

Legal basis

The criteria for this subclass are set out in Schedule 2, Subclass 189 of the Migration Regulations 1994, and applicants must satisfy the criteria applicable at the time of invitation and the time of decision, subject to any transitional arrangements prescribed in the Regulations.

Required documents

  • Valid passport
  • Skills assessment
  • English test result
  • Evidence of work experience
  • Police clearance certificates
